messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PD-INC-8921 fired for gpu-memory-pressure on cluster-west-1. Alert: cuda alloc failures increasing across g4-pool-7 (rate > 5/min). See alert: https://pagerduty.example/PD-INC-8921

pagerduty: Triggered by alert rule `cuda_alloc_error_rate` (threshold 5/min). Auto-escalation in 5m if unacked.

Priya (oncall): ack — I'm on it. Starting triage. Anyone seeing matching logs?

Jared (sre): joining. quick Q: are these OOMs on dedicated instances or shared?

Marta (infra): looks like a mix. Control plane shows 6 pods on g4-pool-7 with `CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED` in stdout. Node events show sporadic oom_kill on processes using kv-cache.

Priya (oncall): customer impact?

support-bot: Affected tenants flagged by routing metrics: [acme-corp, betaapp, playscale]. Estimated ~2% of overall requests failing with 5xx right now.

Leo (eng-runtime): initial hunch: KV cache prefetch + large seq lengths + q8 model => memory pressure spike. We have a lower-memory q4 variant that can take load. Recommend fallback routing to model_variant: rtx-q4-small.

Priya (oncall): ok plan: 1) drain most noisy nodes, 2) patch routing to fallback variant for 30m, 3) scale up pool by 2 nodes as buffer, 4) monitor. I'll perform steps in that order.

Jared (sre): I'll handle node drains and watch kube evictions. Marta, can you pre-warm images on new nodes?

Marta (infra): pre-warming now. Also saw an autoscaler error in the last hour - controller crashed briefly. I'll restart controller if scale doesn't initiate.

Priya (oncall): executing drain on node g4-7a: ```
kubectl cordon g4-7a
kubectl drain g4-7a --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=10m
```

Priya (oncall): patching routing config to prefer rtx-q4-small for model `text-gen-large` with a 100% route for requests from affected pools (temporary):

```
# patching rollout via api
curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/v1/routes/route-patch" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"route_id":"text-gen-large","fallback":"rtx-q4-small","weight":1.0,"ttl":"30m"}'
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty note added: "On-call Priya acknowledged. Performing node drains, routing fallback to q4 variant, scaling +2 nodes. Impact: degraded QoS for some customers, ~2% 5xx rate."

Priya (oncall): scaling pool g4-pool-7 by +2 now: `terraform apply -var 'pool=g4-pool-7' -var 'delta=2'` — starting.

Marta (infra): autoscaler still in weird state. Restarted controller; new scale request accepted and nodes provisioning. Pre-warm container images.

Leo (eng-runtime): patch applied. Traffic for `text-gen-large` now routed to rtx-q4-small for the flagged origin pool. Expect lower per-request memory.

Priya (oncall): after drains + routing, OOM errors are dropping — current error rate down to ~0.8/min. Monitoring token-level errors and latency.

Jared (sre): watching kube events — two pods failed to terminate cleanly during drain, forced delete. I left one pod logs for root cause:

```
2026-03-15T12:40:21Z runtime: cuda: CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED: failed to allocate 1.2GiB
2026-03-15T12:40:22Z runtime: kv-cache: evicting prefix /v1/kv/long-seq (size 820MiB)
2026-03-15T12:40:23Z runtime: handler: RU timeouts increased
```

Priya (oncall): posting to support channel to inform affected customers and request CS draft for status page.

support-bot: Drafting notification to impacted customers: "We're aware of elevated 5xx errors for text generation; working on mitigation; fallback routing applied; engineers are scaling capacity. We'll follow up with timeline." Approve?

Leo (eng-runtime): small perf note — q4 fallback will increase token latency ~12-18% and reduce per-token memory by ~40%. Good short-term tradeoff.

Priya (oncall): Approve message. Sending now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: PD-INC-8921 acknowledged by Priya (oncall). Escalation suppressed.

Marta (infra): new nodes are up and joined cluster, kube ready. Pre-warm complete.

Priya (oncall): scaled nodes +2 done. Routing maintained. Error rate steady at ~0.5/min. Latency spike observed for customers on fallback but no increase in error rate.

Jared (sre): recommend keeping fallback in place for 45-60m and then gradually roll back once kv-cache eviction pressure stabilizes. Also will open a follow-up issue for autoscaler crash root cause.

Priya (oncall): agreed. I'll set a timer. Leaving a handoff note: in 28m I hand to night oncall — @Marta will take over monitoring for next 2h.

Marta (infra): ack. I'll monitor logs and scale if needed.

Priya (oncall): final notes for thread: mitigation executed (drains, fallback routing, +2 nodes). Customer notification sent. Creating incident ticket and postmortem template. :white_check_mark:

Jared (sre): creating ticket now: INC-8921-ROOTCAUSE. Assigning to infra & runtime teams for follow-up.

support-bot: Customers notified: acme-corp (priority contact), betaapp. Affected customers asked to DM for updates.

Priya (oncall): closing high-urgency actions from my side. Will update incident ticket with timeline. If error rate climbs again, re-open PD.

incident-bot: Note: automatic follow-up check in 30m for error-rate regression."
